request.style: English, male solo voice, acoustic guitar, cello, flute, light percussion, solemn, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The word came down in days of old
King Jehoiakim upon the throne
A test for those who lived as told
The Rechabites in their home

[Verse]
To the house of the Lord I went
Into a chamber set aside
Where the sons of Hanan went
With Igdaliah by their side

[Chorus]
He was called the man of God
A name of honor held in trust
Beside the officials it was
Above the keeper of the dust

[Verse]
Bowls of wine were set before
The men who lived in tents all days
But they refused the liquid store
Obeying ancient sacred ways

[Chorus]
He was called the man of God
A name of honor held in trust
Beside the officials it was
Above the keeper of the dust

[Verse]
Jonadab commanded them to keep
No houses sown or vines to grow
They answered with a promise deep
To follow where their fathers go

[Chorus]
He was called the man of God
A name of honor held in trust
Beside the officials it was
Above the keeper of the dust

[Outro]
In that chamber of the Lord
The man of God is remembered well
